This video was made possible thanks to everyone on the Simple History Patreon: https://www.patreon.com/simplehistory

Was the Highway of Death a justified military strike or a war crime? During the final days of the 1991 Gulf War, coalition aircraft devastated retreating Iraqi forces along Highway 80. Explore what happened, why the attack became so controversial, and the arguments that continue to surround it.
